The [[Lynx]] is a [[charmable animal]] that is native to [[Kryta]].

==Locations==
*[[Core]]
**[[The Battle Isles]]
***{{NPC location|Zaishen Menagerie Grounds}} (levels 5, 12, 15, and 20, depending on unlock progress)
*[[Prophecies]]
**[[Kryta]]
***{{NPC location|North Kryta Province}} (closest spawn is right outside [[Lion's Arch]])
***{{NPC location|Stingray Strand}}
***{{NPC location|Talmark Wilderness}} (left of [[Temple of the Ages]], past a [[resurrection shrine]])
***{{NPC location|Twin Serpent Lakes}}
***{{NPC location|Watchtower Coast}}

==Missions==
*Prophecies
**[[Kryta]]
***{{NPC location|D'Alessio Seaboard}} (in the northwest corner, near the destination for the bonus objective)
***{{NPC location|Gates of Kryta}} (at the start of the mission or near [[Oink]])
***{{NPC location|Riverside Province}} (at the start of the mission and outside the fort where [[Dinas]] is found)
***{{NPC location|Sanctum Cay}} (northwestern corner and near where [[Vizier Khilbron]] spawns)

==Notes==
*Lynxes deal [[slashing damage]].
*[[Zaishen_Menagerie_Grounds/Service_costs|Unlocking cost]]: 1{{zsilver}} plus 100{{gold}} or 1,000 [[Balthazar Faction]] ''(Common, Tyria)''

== Trivia ==
* During early alpha testing of the game, lynxes were available in many different colors, as mentioned by an alpha tester in the Photics e-zine issue #3<ref>https://photics.com/issues/issue03.pdf</ref> of March 2004.
